description: DELETION_CONFIGS gains a service_request_definition entry (supportsArchive true, supportsInactive false) with a blocking 'submission' dependency on service_request_submissions.definition_id
service_request_definition config has a blocking 'checklist apply rule' dependency counted via countPredicateReferences('checklist_template_apply_rules', 'where', 'service_request_definition_id')
preCheckDeletion maps entity type service_request_definition to the 'service' permission resource (delete action)

deleteServiceRequestDefinitionFromManagement validates and deletes in one transaction via deleteEntityWithValidation('service_request_definition', ...) and returns DeletionValidationResult & { deleted }
Domain delete returns a NOT_FOUND result for a definition that does not exist in the tenant
Domain delete clears service_request_audience tag references and the definition row (tenant-scoped) inside the transaction; versions and answer mappings cascade
An FK violation (23503) during the delete is caught and turned into the re-validated blocked result instead of a raw error
SERVICE_REQUEST_DEFINITION_DELETED is published only when the delete succeeded, so the search index row is removed
deleteServiceRequestDefinitionAction server action gated on requireServiceRequestPermission(user, 'delete') (MSP-only) delegates to the domain delete

Shared service-request delete dialog component wraps DeleteEntityDialog + useDeletionValidation('service_request_definition'): validates on open, confirm calls the delete action, 'archive' alternative calls the archive action, archive alternative stripped for already-archived forms, custom translated confirmation message
Management list row menu has a Delete item (Trash2 icon, after Archive/Unarchive) that opens the shared dialog; success reloads the list and toasts
Definition editor header has a Delete button using the shared dialog; success navigates back to /msp/service-requests

New strings (management.actions.delete, editor.delete, deleteDialog.confirmation, messages.success.definitionDeleted, messages.error.deleteFailed) added to msp/service-requests.json in every locale, pseudo-locales regenerated, validate-translations passes
Existing caller (serviceRequestAudienceScoping integration test) still compiles and passes against the new return shape
